Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as molecule_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name aliased as molecule_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then join compound_records to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to include canonical_smiles even when structures are missing. Filter where docs.chembl_id equals CHEMBL4304757. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending. Do not deduplicate rows.
